method: full-text archive (agent/terms-archive, 2026-11-25): every archived terms/help paragraph matching the discretion, sanction, rule-change, separate-agreement, asymmetry and consistency lexicons reviewed by hand; sanction clauses re-read in the full text

facts.text: ETF 'reserves the right to withhold or delay Rewards ... if it determines, in its sole discretion, that a User has engaged in behavior that is inconsistent with or in violations of the Terms', and retains 'the sole and absolute discretion to determine whether a Trader's trading behavior is in accordance with the Terms'.
Prohibited conduct includes 'conduct or activities that, in ETF's sole discretion creates, reputational, regulatory, or financial risk to ETF'.

ETF may modify the Terms 'including Reward limits and eligibility requirements, ATD limits, drawdown limits, or any other parameters of the LIVE ELITE Account', and may convert a trader to LIVE ELITE 'at any time, before, during, or after a Reward request'.
Emotional or gambling-like trading may be a supporting factor, but ETF 'will not deny a Reward based on this subsection (t) alone'; reducing account limits does not close accounts already held.
